name: Rary's Telepathic Bond

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: up to eight willing creatures you can see

summary: Link up to eight willing creatures so they can talk mind to mind.
text: Creatures with Intelligence 2 or lower are unaffected. The link works at any distance on the same plane, regardless of shared language.
